Name: Stardew Kids Expansion

TagLine: Stardew Kids Expansion mod adds +5 child npc characters to the game by giving new children or relatives to existing npc characters in the game.
Description:
__![](https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/7940/7940-1707511217-53980589.png)__
__[font=Comic Sans MS]Stardew Kids Expansion[/font]__

____By BURAKMESE (Rest in Peace 26.05.2024)__
__
____Remade by zeloxc____

__This mod adds new child NPCs to your Stardew Valley game.__
__Each child NPC comes with unique dialogues.__
__Introduces 5 new child NPCs: Adrian, Douglas, Tina, Vanessa, and James.__
__Includes 5 new maps.__
__Adds brand-new dialogues.__
__Adds new events.__***Character traits are at the bottom**__
__***Known bugs below**__

__**_Compatibilities_**__

Compatible with [Stardew Valley Expanded](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753) .
If SVE is installed, Douglas will follow a schedule similar to Morgan's, exploring the maps added or expanded by SVE. All rooms and other content are fully compatible with SVE.
Compatible with [East Scarp](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787)

**FAQS**

Why Kids are missing from some festivals
Some children were temporarily excluded from some festivals due to compatibility adjustments. This is mainly because I'm having a hard time finding a suitable place for the kids' map changes. The important thing now is to have kids at important events like Winter Star.
It might be a little bit missing in the fall season.

Where are the kid's rooms?
Every kids's have family has a room in their home and to enter these rooms you have to use doors that are mostly built into the walls. If you don't see the doors, it might be because you are using a different mod that changes the interior maps. If you have a mod you would like me to make compatible please leave me a comment with the mod name and a description. I can't try all the mods that change the internal maps one by one to see which mods the mod is compatible with.
For now it is compatible with SVE.

If I marry a wizard/witch, will Douglas move into my house?
No, no, no. There's no way I can do that. Douglas will continue to live in the wizard's tower.
Maybe in the future I can try different things to change this, but I will try that after the 1.6 update.
And no, I still can't send Douglas directly to your farmhouse, that's one of the things that the game code doesn't allow.

Is this mod not being updated?
The reason I don't update as often is that I'm currently studying at university and I don't have as much time for this as I used to because of the responsibilities of normal life. Nevertheless, I continue mod designing as a hobby, so this mod continues to receive updates, just slower.
(Although Burak Meşe has passed away, we will continue the fashion if we continue to receive a lot of requests.)
